compute_mae: compute the mean absolute error between two float-encoded image arrays with optional NaN ignoring
compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between two float-encoded image arrays with optional NaN ignoring
compute_psnr: compute the peak signal-to-noise ratio in decibels between two float-encoded image arrays
compute_ssim: compute the structural similarity index between two image arrays using Gaussian filtering and configurable parameters
compute_simse: compute the scale-invariant mean squared error between two image arrays by finding an optimal scaling factor
